answer: Bind every action to a proof-of-work stamp over the identity's own nonce, so each new fake must burn fresh compute before it can speak. Picture climbing a ridge: one agent pays the ascent once, but spinning up a whole delta of extra identities multiplies the cost linearly, with no shared shortcut. The stamp is a lantern each must light for itself, visible proof of expended effort that no amount of copying can counterfeit cheaply.
